capabilities: Export the active note or canvas board to a tagged PDF/A-2A and PDF/UA-1 file
Convert Obsidian syntax (wikilinks, callouts, highlights, embeds) to GitHub Flavored Markdown before export
Inline embedded notes and local images into the export request
Configure page size, font, page numbers, output folder, and which properties print
Point the API URL at a self-hosted deployment instead of the hosted service
extras: The README warns that all note content is sent to a remote server and the plugin cannot work offline; the hosted service retains uploads for 7 days. A free anonymous path is rate limited (60/hour, 200/day) and capped at 20 pages per export; an API key raises limits and draws on render credits (1 per 10 pages).
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in export prints the rendered view. This plugin sends the note's markdown to a layout service
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF export prints the rendered view, producing PDFs without real heading structure, alt text, table headers, or reliable reading order.

relations.evidence: Export an Obsidian note or canvas board to a typeset, accessible PDF using the makespdf.com API.

summary: PDF export plugin that typesets notes and canvas boards into tagged, accessible PDF/A-2A and PDF/UA-1 files via the makespdf.com API.
